name: GRA04 frameset

editorial.verdict: A rational alternative to LightCarbon; choose by geometry, delivered price, and local communication rather than carbon-grade marketing.
caveats: Package contents and domestic quote need confirmation

purchase_route: The current exact-model ICAN page provides a manufacturer Get a quote form for GRA04. No public fixed price is displayed and the form was not submitted; confirm package, finish, shipping, tax, mainland delivery and warranty in the written quote.
